mainEntity.name: How can AEO improve my pest control company's online visibility in specific cities like New York City?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO significantly enhances local online visibility. By optimizing your website's content for specific city-based queries, such as 'pest control New York City' or 'termite treatment NYC,' search engines can more accurately match your services to local users seeking solutions. This involves creating localized content that directly answers common pest issues in New York City, uses relevant local keywords, and ensures your business information is consistent across all online directories. This targeted approach helps your business rank higher in local search results and appear in featured snippets for local questions.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO improves local visibility by optimizing content with city-specific keywords and answering local queries, helping your pest control company rank higher in local search results and featured snippets.
